Choosing the right heating company is essential for safety, performance and long term reliability. At Dodsworth Gas Services, we are a trusted provider of professional heating, boiler and plumbing services throughout Leeds and the surrounding areas.
With extensive hands on experience across domestic and commercial systems, we deliver safe, efficient and technically reliable solutions tailored to every property.

Our qualified engineers specialise in boiler installations, servicing and repairs, commercial heating and plant rooms, LPG boilers, air source heat pumps, central and underfloor heating, plumbing and Landlord Gas Safety Certificates.

Heating and plumbing systems are critical to comfort, safety and day to day operation. That’s why all work carried out by Dodsworth Gas Services follows current industry regulations and manufacturer guidance.
